description: Logs in to Gamealia with a device code; call it first, since every tool that talks to Gamealia needs it. Returns a URL and a code at once for the user to open and approve (Google, or email and password; creates the developer profile if needed), then polls in the background and stores the API key in ~/.config/gamealia/credentials.json (mode 600). Call again with wait:true to wait for the approval (up to 50 s per call; repeat while still pending). When already logged in it only returns the username, unless force:true.

force.description: Start a new login even when already logged in (cancels a pending one)

wait.description: Wait up to 50 s for the user to approve a login started earlier

name: gamealia_login
title: Log in to Gamealia
